verdict.rationale: All evidence describes PayPal's agentic commerce as checkout-flow based (carts, ACP/UCP delegated tokens, Store Sync, agent toolkit for orders/refunds/disputes) — none of it describes HTTP 402 status-code machine payments or per-call API monetization without a checkout UI, which is a distinct technical pattern. Since PayPal is a payments platform, this axis could plausibly apply, but there is no evidence it ships or supports the 402 pay-per-call mechanism described in the story.
